# Figure spec — per-BGC domain strip (`<Strain>_<BGC>_domain_strip.png`)

**Generated by:** `mamey.domain_figures.render_domain_figures` (Figure C).
**Source table:** `domain_level/domain_rows_long.csv` (ordered by `cds_start`).

## Purpose
A node-first, left-to-right map of the protein domains in one top-lead BGC, each arrow
colored by its biosynthetic role category. Shows assembly-line architecture (or its absence)
at a glance, separate from the AB/AF score.

## Layout rules
1. Title is node/contig-first, then BGC id: `"<Strain> <NODE...> (<BGC>) domain architecture"`.
2. One arrow per domain, in genomic order; arrow direction follows CDS strand.
3. Arrow fill = role category from `domain_role_taxonomy.v1.json`, palette from
   `domain_figure_specs.v1.json` (`role_palette`).
4. A role legend (categories present in the strip), not a raw per-domain key.
5. If a BGC exceeds `max_strip_domains` (default 40), show the first N and add
   "(first N of M shown)" to the title — the figure receipt records the collapse.
6. Domain-name labels are short (truncated ~12 chars), angled to avoid overlap.

## Claim-safety
Roles are structural. The strip is architecture evidence, never a product-identity claim.

## Companion outputs
`figure_manifest.csv` row (filename, source_table, row_count, dimensions, status).
